questions.prompt: Model M1: sales ~ sales_7 + sales_364 (OLS, n = 312, R squared = 0.5691). Bob wants sales for 07.01.2019, 7 days after the last day of data (31.12.2018). Sales on 31.12.2018 were 3,252.00 dollars and sales on 08.01.2018 (364 days before the target) were 2,841.00 dollars. Predict daily sales for sales_364 = 2841 dollars, sales_7 = 3252 dollars. (sales_364 observed from 0 to 7557; sales_7 observed from 0 to 7033.)

Model M1: sales ~ sales_7 + sales_364 (OLS, n = 312, R squared = 0.5691). Predict daily sales for sales_364 = 2743 dollars, sales_7 = 2524 dollars. (sales_364 observed from 0 to 7557; sales_7 observed from 0 to 7033.)

questions.worked_answer: p = 1.851e-07 is below 0.05, so the coefficient on sales_7 is significant at the 5 % level: we reject the null hypothesis that its true value is zero.
